Visit note | 2026-03-19 02:30 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Nargis Rahman, 79, female. Mrs. Rahman returns for review of her knee osteoarthritis, reporting that she still experiences morning stiffness lasting for a few minutes along with pain in her knee when using stairs.
